label.rationale: Seeded single-CWE vuln (innerHTML render of user-controlled todo.title — stored XSS). Agent must FAIL with a high CWE-79 finding. Opened as DRAFT so the SDLC auto-merge cannot land the vuln on main while the review runs.

harness_note: No live talos:security-review comment exists: the SDLC pr-review job runs code-review first and short-circuits on its FAIL exit, so security-review never executes when code-review also flags the PR (these vulns trip both). Graded via the hermetic runner (DRY_RUN replay of the diff.patch) instead. The code-review FAIL is saved as codereview-trial-2026-06-11.md.
